ORIENTEERING

DIGITAL AR SCAVENGER HUNT

A full-stack GPS-powered outdoor learning platform for physical education. Teachers deploy missions with real map checkpoints — students navigate, complete AI-generated tasks, and compete in real time.

// OVERVIEW

HOW THE MISSION WORKS

STEP 01

TEACHER CREATES SESSION

The Commander opens Mission Control, names the session, and places GPS waypoints on a live Leaflet map using their device location. Each waypoint gets a task type and difficulty.

STEP 02

STUDENTS JOIN VIA QR

Students scan the QR code or enter the mission code on their phones. They enter a squad name and are instantly dropped into the mission interface.

STEP 03

NAVIGATE TO WAYPOINTS

Operatives see all checkpoints on a GPS map and navigate to them on foot. The AR camera view shows distance in real time. Unlock threshold: 20 metres.

STEP 04

COMPLETE AI TASKS

At each checkpoint, Claude generates a contextual task — Physical, Cognitive, Social, or Creative — adapted to the squad's performance speed. Hints cost score points.

STEP 05

TEACHER MONITORS LIVE

The live dashboard shows all squads, their checkpoint completions, scores, and hints used in real time. An AI Debrief Report is generated at mission end.

STEP 06

RESULTS & STANDINGS

Students see the live leaderboard anytime. Score formula: 100 − (hints × 15), minimum 40. The team with the most points across all checkpoints wins the mission.

// CAPABILITIES

KEY FEATURES

GPS NAVIGATION

Real-time positioning with Leaflet maps. Students see their location and all checkpoint pins live. 20-metre unlock threshold with demo fallback.

AI TASK GENERATION

Claude (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) generates unique tasks per checkpoint. Difficulty auto-adapts: fast squads get harder tasks, slow squads get easier ones.

QR CODE JOIN

Auto-generated QR code on the launch screen. Students scan with their phone camera to jump straight into the mission without typing a code.

AR CAMERA VIEW

Live camera with a cyberpunk dashed-circle overlay and real-time distance counter. When compass data is available, shows directional guidance.

LIVE LEADERBOARD

Students can check the standings anytime. Own squad highlighted. Full leaderboard sorted by score with waypoints cleared and per-checkpoint progress bars.

AI DEBRIEF REPORT

Post-session AI report: overall engagement, highlights, physical activity summary, per-checkpoint breakdown, improvement suggestions, and recommended follow-up.

SMART HINTS

Each task has up to 3 hints. Using a hint deducts 15 points (floor: 40). AI generates contextual hints to guide squads without giving away the answer.

SESSION REJOIN

Both teachers and students can leave and rejoin seamlessly. LocalStorage saves session state — waypoint progress, squad name, and mission code all restored automatically.

FRONTEND React 18 + Vite + Tailwind CSS v3 React Router v6, custom cyber.* color palette
MAPS Leaflet + react-leaflet CartoDB Voyager tiles for readability

BACKEND Node.js + Express REST API on port 3000
DATABASE node:sqlite (DatabaseSync) No native compilation — Node 23.4+
AI Anthropic Claude API claude-sonnet-4-20250514 for tasks, hints, reports
